***SAVE THE DATES!!!******SAVE THE DATES!!!******SAVE THE DATES!!!******

The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), New Orleans District, is conducting a one-day Industry Day event.

The Industry Day will provide industry-specific information that focuses on active USACE projects in South Louisiana over the next 18 months, and is open to all interested contractors, large and small businesses, joint ventures, academia, as well as other Government stakeholders.

Projects include:

Comite River Diversion Project

West Shore Lake Pontchartrain Project

East Baton Rouge Flood Management Project Mississippi River Levee Construction

Morganza to the Gulf, Humble Canal Preload Contract Southeast Louisiana

Atchafalaya Basin

Southwest Coastal

Facilities & Physical Support

Locks & Structures

Dredging

A-E Outlook

Studies & Possible Future Opportunities

DATE: May 14, 2026

LOCATION: USACE New Orleans District Headquarters (Both Events)

District Assembly Room

7400 Leake Avenue,

New Orleans, LA 70118

The Industry Day will provide opportunities for industry to meet one-on-one with USACE technical personnel for the outlined projects above via breakout sessions on a First-Come, First-Served basis, allows Contractor presentation time slots on a First-Come, First-Served basis, and renders the opportunities for Vendors and Professional Organizations to setup table displays on a First-Come, First-Served basis, as well.

These events are free of charge. All attendees will be required to pre-register for the event(s) they plan on attending. A tentative agenda will be uploaded to this announcement mid-March along with the registration form and link, so interested parties should check SAM.GOV for future updates to this notice.
